Sumitomo Osaka Cement.why: Its Optoelectronics business makes lithium niobate (LN) optical modulators for optical communications networks and data centers; the FY2026-28 plan launches a next-generation LN modulator (CDM) and ultra-high-speed optical modulation sub-assemblies, so optical-network build-outs drive its LN modulator sales.
Sumitomo Osaka Cement.evidence: Sumitomo Osaka Cement FY2026-28 Medium-Term Management Plan (05-13-2026): 'In the LN modulator business, launch sales of next-generation product (CDM) and prepare to sell ultra-high-speed optical modulation components (sub-assemblies).'

players.product: Lithium niobate (LN) optical modulators for optical communications, incl. next-generation LN modulator (CDM) and ultra-high-speed optical modulation sub-assemblies

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Osaka Cement results presentation: Explanatory Materials for Financial Results Q1 FY2026 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (April-June 2026): net sales 56,100mn yen (+8.8% YoY) and operating profit 3,460mn yen (+99.1% YoY), mainly on domestic cement price hikes; High-Performance Products operating profit 740mn yen (-17.0% YoY) as higher electrostatic chuck volume was offset by one-time relocation expenses, depreciation of the new production facility and development expenses. Optoelectronics segment net sales 8 (FY2025 Q1: 7) and operating profit 1.0 (FY2025 Q1: -0.1), unit 100 million yen
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales 56,100mn yen; Optoelectronics net sales 8 (100 million yen), operating profit 1.0

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 forecast unchanged from May 13: net sales 234,500mn yen (+4.8% YoY), operating profit 15,000mn yen (+9.9% YoY); High-Performance Products operating profit 4,200mn yen (+73.4% YoY) on higher electrostatic chuck volume with a semiconductor demand recovery; Optoelectronics forecast net sales 28 and operating profit 0.0 (FY2025: 27 and -0.6), unit 100 million yen. Company: Q1 progress against the forecast was high but the forecast is kept because exchange rates and energy prices remain uncertain
